_ExcludeSerials_note: Drives skipped entirely (no checks, no missing alert). Match by serial because letters/disk numbers can change. Example: <DRIVE_SERIAL>.
_PriorityLetters_note: Drives listed first and tagged as priority in alerts/reports.
_Thresholds_note: HddTempC: alert when an HDD reaches this temp. LowFreePct: alert when a drive's free space drops below this percent. NvmeWearPct: alert when an NVMe drive's 'percentage used' (rated life used) reaches this.
